remaining_fast_tests.network_guard: Temporary socket-denying sitecustomize, with no production changes.

isolated_artifact_smoke.limits: moto, Spark/Glue stubs; no real Spark JVM or AWS.

rerun.independence: Perturb each Glue script/Spark/requirements; add job; remove all Glue jobs one by one; other artifacts stay identical. Declared local public consumers rebuild only when their dependencies change.
rerun.manifest_and_deploy_references: Layout tests confirm three independent Glue artifact pairs and explicit contract/job routing. Terraform source differs only by a comment.
rerun.unchanged_implementation: git diff vs d75ebec: protocol, contracts, all Glue implementations/requirements, Lambda implementation, publisher/generator implementation, SQL, dbt, Airflow, pyproject and uv.lock unchanged.

previous_evidence_reused_not_rerun.reason: Business/runtime implementations and published contracts unchanged except the explicitly mapped runner routing covered by a local service-double test. Terraform only has a comment correction; deployed resource expressions are unchanged.

residual_risks: Real Spark/Glue/Athena/Iceberg and corrected Lambda on AWS remain unvalidated; offline results do not prove managed runtime access or performance.
Independent Glue artifacts/deploy references share the existing project Terraform state and ingestion IAM role; no mandatory shared implementation was introduced.
Deploy with jobs idle: old content keys can be removed during updates. Git rollback requires rebuild/test/deploy and does not revert data/schema/state.
Other documented historical limitations remain unchanged; no new AWS inventory was queried.
